int process_string_split_index(char* str) {
    int length = 0;
    int spaces = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    
    while (str[length] != '\0') {
        if (str[length] == ' ') spaces++;
        if (str[length] >= '0' && str[length] <= '9') digits++;
        length++;
    }
    
    return length + spaces * 2 + digits * 3;
}

        result = result + 0.001;
        counter = counter + 1;
    }}
    
    return 0;
}}
